name: Dvizhimyj zhelaniem
source:
You are a simple guy from the village, who has just recently finished his studies and is immersed in the village routine. Every day you run your father's errands: chopping wood, taking care of the animals on the farm, and in the evenings having fun with your two best friends. 

  But he asks himself the question - “What will happen in the future? Will I really live my whole life in the countryside?” 

  What decision will he make? Will he conquer his fear and go off into the unknown to meet adventures and beautiful girls, or will he stay in the village forever?

[From [url=https://kloppstyle.itch.io/driven-by-desire]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一个来自乡村的简单小伙子，刚刚完成学业，沉浸在乡村生活中。每天你都在替父亲做事：砍柴、照顾农场里的动物，以及晚上和两个最好的朋友一起玩耍。

  但他问自己一个问题：“未来会发生什么？我真的会在农村度过一生吗？” 

  他会做出什么决定？他会克服恐惧，前往未知的地方去遇见冒险和美丽的女孩，还是会永远留在村庄里？

[来自[url=https://kloppstyle.itch.io/driven-by-desire]itch.io[/url]]
